scope: Development screening and adaptive shortlisting before opening the fresh validation set. No live publication.

development.selection: Prefer full coverage, zero false positives/misses/unnecessary reviews, and all intended spam automatically caught. Among passing arms prefer lower reported cost, then smaller protocol change. If none pass, preserve failures and revise only on development evidence; do not declare a winner.
development.stressSet: The 64 previously inspected Clef cascade cases are reused only as development stress evidence, never as a fresh holdout.

validation.requirements: Full classification coverage and known cost/identity; catch the target bait patterns; no false positives, no new misses or incorrect review decisions across repeat perturbations. Compare policy-only versus protocol effects separately. Repeated orders are not independent observations.
validation.historicalRegression: Use frozen owner-labelled text references as retrospective evidence, separately from fresh synthetic validation. Preserve safety/invalid-output failures and unknown billing without replay.
